text: The portal opened, and the family tumbled back into their kitchen, right where they'd started. The Nintendo was fixed. Breakfast was still warm. And best of all — Lili and Leo weren't fighting anymore.

speaker: narrator

speaker: narrator
text: And they all sat down and ate breakfast together — the happiest family in any world, real or video game. THE END.
